hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=(j.toolCall&&j.toolCall.args&&j.toolCall.args.CommandLine)||'';const risky=/git\s+push\s+--force|\b(DROP\s+TABLE|TRUNCATE)\b|rm\s+-rf\s+\/(\s|$)/i.test(cmd);console.log(JSON.stringify(risky?{decision:'force_ask',reason:'Perintah berisiko terdeteksi oleh KruAI hook.'}:{decision:'allow'}));}catch{console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'}));}});"
